headline: Camden Property Trust Announces Second Quarter 2026 Operating Results
summary: HOUSTON, July 30, 2026--Camden Property Trust (NYSE:CPT) (the "Company") announced today operating results for the three and six months ended June 30, 2026. Net Income Attributable to Common Shareholders ("EPS"), Funds from Operations ("FFO"), Core Funds from Operations ("Core FFO"), and Core Adjusted Funds from Operations ("Core AFFO") for the three and six months ended June 30, 2026 are detailed below. A reconciliation of EPS to FFO, Core FFO, and Core AFFO is included in the financial tables
